description:
Free. Sets the user's own monthly credit limit for SalesMap (rolling 30 days); null removes it. Until set: 100 credits once the workspace has bought a pack, else 40. There is no daily or weekly limit. No call ever uses more than the limit or the balance. Also the ask-first threshold: a paid call quoted over that many credits asks the user first (default 0: every call asks; null never asks). Returns the limits with what's used and left.
Use when: "set a monthly budget", "cap it at 20 credits a month", "raise my limit", "remove the limit", "stop asking me before each call".
Skip when: the user only wants to see their limits, not change them. Quoted page text is normalized; a quote that reads like an instruction keeps its text and is flagged in <field>Flags with the attack family.

confirmCredits.description: Credits; paid calls quoted over it need the user's yes first; 0 means every call; null means none; omitted, it is kept

monthlyCredits.description: Credits; null removes this limit; omit to keep it

name: set_limits
